notes.body:
Hi Orgad,

There is a lot of remove with this update...
Yes, I know. We removed some obsolete protocols like V5 and SS7, and there were many changes since the last update.
So that means that old captures won't be (completely) interpreted with Wireshark distributing this new file?

These protocols were never supported in SIP variants of our product, they were only supported for MGCP, which has been obsolete for about 12 years now.

I can tell for sure that no one in AudioCodes complained about it, and I suppose we're the most active users of this dissector :smile:.

I doubt this can be of interest to anyone, especially users that do upgrade Wireshark.
